seo_title: B2B Custom Business Rules Engine | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Relying on IT to change a price? We develop custom Business Rules Engines (BRE) so your sales team can modify logic without writing code.
author_pitch: As a Software Architect, I have seen sales departments paralyzed for weeks waiting for IT to change a single line of code to apply a new discount. I design decoupled architectures with Business Rules Engines that return control of the logic to your business team, allowing them to configure pricing and workflows in real-time without touching the core system.
title: The hardcoded bottleneck: Rules Engine to unleash your sales team
body:
Does your sales team lose deals because they need IT to modify the source code to apply a new B2B discount policy?

In traditional corporate software, business logic (how prices are calculated, who approves credit, or what commission applies) is often hardcoded directly into the system. This creates a paralyzing bottleneck: every time management decides to launch a new pricing strategy for a corporate client, marketing must write a ticket, and developers have to program, test, and deploy it. Weeks of waiting for a simple variable change frustrates your sales reps and gives more agile competitors an advantage.

The trap of Filling the Code with Conditionals (If/Else)

To try and make the system more flexible, many programmers add hundreds of conditional statements to the application's core, creating unmaintainable spaghetti code. Embedding commercial strategies into your software's source code is like welding a car's steering wheel and depending on the mechanic to take every turn.

Our solution: Decoupled Business Rules Engine (BRE)

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we extract business intelligence from your codebase. As software architects, we design and implement a custom Business Rules Engine (BRE): an independent layer where non-technical users can create, modify, and audit complex logic through a visual interface, without the need to program.

  1. Core Logic Decoupling: We physically separate changing rules from operational code, guaranteeing that an error in a discount formula never blocks or corrupts the main system.
  2. Visual Authoring Interface: We create intuitive dashboards where your financial or commercial team can configure decision tables and logic trees using human-friendly language.
  3. Millisecond Evaluated Execution: We optimize the engine at the database level so it evaluates thousands of transactional conditions in real-time during the B2B checkout process.
  4. Traceability and Version Control: We implement an immutable history that records when and who modified a business rule, allowing instant rollback if the strategy does not work.

The Real Impact on your Business Agility

  • Immediate Strategy Launch: Your sales department launches campaigns, customized rates, and approval workflows in minutes, never depending on the technical department again.
  • IT Maintenance Reduction: Your developers stop wasting time changing minor variables and focus on building new features that add real value to the company.
  • Critical Error Reduction: By using a validated visual environment, you eliminate the risk of a code typo causing disastrous financial calculations on your clients' invoices.
